book.title: 2 PITA Pitato Pepa Lapone Peyo Pee Peleane Oko

content: Akali Andane Oko Bala Epolopeya Leane Oko

Nambana yamapane yene yame, wamba Gotena potopesa akali tupamane mangene Goteto matili pulupeya tupana pii lapanawa leainipia. Wuane leai-kola, matili yakamana aposolo akali tupamane pii yakama molo-peke lalane Akali Andane Jisasato leane tupa yakama languato, wua piyapape leai okoni. Andipa yakamato pii akali utupane-mane wamba leaini tupa nembo tolo-peke lapiai lakae lo nembo toto, nambato yakamana nembo-tene epene oko lapone mina ika loto, yakamana pepa lapone oko peyo epe leyo.

Wamba aposolo akali utupane-mane pii mindi yakama languato, yuu oko koyo puyale pula-angi, lamba lalaini wandakali minditupa atolopeyai leai okoni. Yakamato pii okone bulupane nembo talapape. Lamba lalaini wandakali utupane-mane yakamana nembo-tene koo oko wato minuto, yakama ando lamba loto, wua lolopeyai: Wamba Jisasato potomisa pii mindi leane oko loto, namba peke lokale leane tekeko, wamba wete Goteto yuu ati-la yakale leane gii okonena atoto, andipa ateyama okona giau loto, minditaka eya tupa pitaka lawa napene, mee wamba yane okonepene teke eya okonde. Nanimana yumbane tupa oma yiake leaini tekeko, bala peke naleya okonde lolopeyai.

Goteto minditaka wamba mo lawa peane tupa wayumane nembo tolo-peke nalene ato, utupane-mane wuane lolopeyai. Wamba wete Goteto ati lipi oko ateakale lalu, yuu oko ipa tupana tombenenga yakale lalu, peaipia.
Wuane piyu, matili Goteto ipa lii andane mindi epeakale lea-kola, ipa lii epeane okonemane minditaka wamba yuu okona yane tupa pitaka wetete minu koyaepia.

Dee, andipa Goteto pii mindiki okonemane teke yuu ati-la, okolapo mee yakale lo ando ateya tekeko, matili Goteto bala masia mawua atolaini wandakali tupa kosimi loto, minu koyola-angi, balato yuu ati-la, okonelapo ita-mane yangokale lo maliyo ateya.

Balato okonelapo yangokale lo maliyo ateya okonena, wandakali minditupa-mane loto, Akali Andane oko bala peke lokale lo potomisa pii leane tekeko, bala wamba ini peke naleya, okonde lalaini. Utupane-mane wuane lalaini tekeko, nambana yamapane yene yame, yakamato pii mindiki oko embesa naene, wua lo nembo talapape: Akali Andane okomane andeya-kola, oto mindiki angu mali tausene mindi gulalane. Dee, balato andeya-kola, mali tausene mindi ole mindiki angu gulalane nembo toto, balato mangene minditupa wamba ini kapoyale napiyane. Tene okonena, wandakali-mane loto, Akali Andane okomane mangene mindi pukale lo potomisa pii leane okone balato wamba ini pii napeya, okonde nalape-pene. Jia. Balato wandakali mindikipi mindi alu napeakale nembo toto, yakama towa wamba ini kepa na-alane. Jia. Wandakali pitaka yamapane peke leakale lo maliyo atoto, bala ati kenga atala yuunga ini kapoyale peke naleya.
Yakamana Bilipi Oko Auwa Tepa Olaini, Tika Ando Atalapape Leane Oko

Andipa Akali Andane oko bala wamba ini naepene, mee maliyo ateya tekeko, pake nalane akali mindi bala oko angi epolopeya lo nanimato nembo natene atoloma-kola, bala epalane. Wuane pua teke, Akali Andane bala oko angi epolopeya lo nanimato nembo natene atoloma-kola, bala epolopeya. Okone angi, ati lipi oko tula andane loto, alu pulupeya. Wuane pula-angi, ati lipi okona minditaka eya tupa pitaka ita-mane taa yiake lola-kola, alu pulupeyai. Dee, yuu okopi, yuu okona minditaka yakale lene eya tupapi, utupane pitaka taa yiake loto, alu pulupeyai.
Matili minditaka eya utupane pitaka ita-mane taa yiake loto, alu pulu-peyako. Andipa yakama tane Gote mawuato, yakamato Gotena mana epene tupa wato minu atape-pene.

Wuane puato, yakamato Gotena gii okone wamba ini kapoyale ipupia lakae lo nembo toto, maliyo atalapape. Gii okone epola-angi, ati lipi oko ita-mane taa yiake lola-kola, alu pulupeya. Wuane pula-angi, ita-mane tolane okone toto andane wete pula-kola, yuu oko koyalu, mee ipa yale yolopeya.

Matili yuu ati-la andipa eya okolapo wuane pua koyolo-peyapi tekeko, wamba Goteto potomisa pii mindi leane oko loto, matili nambato yuu ati-la wenene mindi yakale lolowa-kola, yuu wenene okonena wandakali atolai utupane-mane mana epene tika-pene tupa angu wato minu atolopeyai leaipia. Goteto yuu wenene mindi yakale lokale leane okone yata yakale lo nanimato maliyo ateyama.

Nambana yamapane yene yame, Goteto wuane peakale lo yakamato maliyo atoto, bala yanda pimawua ata napene, bala towa yamapane mindiki palu atalapape. Wuane pua atoto, balana wenonga yakamanga koo tene mindi nayene, yakama kilini lene epene wete atamakale nembo toto, yakamato piape taimane pua atalapape. Yakamato wuane pua atolai-kola, matili Akali Andane oko bala epola-angi, yakamato mana epene minu atolaini utupane balato andolopeya.

Akali Andane okomane wandakali kambua tupa molo-peke lokale nembo toto, bala yuunga kapoyale peke naleya lo yakamato nembo talapape. Wamba Goteto nanimana yamapane yene amene Polo balanga nembo-tene epene mindi maya-kola, balato pii nambato pepa peleyo mindiki okonepene teke mindi pepanga peyo epe loto, yakama langea okoni.

Pii nambato pepa peyo epe leyo okonepene teke loto, Polo balatopi balana pepa tupa pitakana pii okonepene tupa teke loto, peyalane. Pii balato pepanga peyo yata yane eya utupanena minditupana tene tupa ayiawa wete andape-pene guleya-kola, Gotena pii tupa wayumane mana mia napene wandakali atalaini tupamane pii utupanena tene tupa tatake alaini. Wandakali utupanena bilipi oko tai ya napeya-kola, utupane-mane Polona pii tupapi, Gotena pii waka pepa pelene eya tupapi, pii utupane pitakana tene enene oko lamai napene, pii waka tupa lamawua atalaini. Tene okonena, matili Goteto wandakali utupane minu koyolo-peya.

Nambana yamapane yene yame, Gotena loo tanga lalaini wandakali utupane-mane epoto, owato pii mana minditupa yakama langulu-peyai oko yakamato nemboto ateyai okoni. Utupane-mane wuane puato, yakama kilau lo molai-kola, yakamato yakamana bilipi oko awua tepa olomane. Tika ando atalapape.

Yakamato wuane pulumane lo ando atoto, nanima molo-peke lalane Akali Andane Jisasa Kataisa balato wua puato, yakama ondo wete alane lo yakamato wayumane wete mana mo atalapape. Mana okone mo atoto, andipapi, matilipi, wandakali-mane balana gene oko laiyu lo atape-pene. Enene.
